description: Reads current UnClick Orchestrator continuity so a seat can interpret a freshly saved turn before acting. Use immediately after save_conversation_turn in the required Log -> Read -> Decide -> Reply -> Log reply gate. If this read fails, say CONTEXT_UNREAD or UNTETHERED instead of guessing whether a phrase is a test cue, real request, blocker, proof, or status.

compact.description: Return compact source summaries by default.

include_raw.description: Include raw fields when explicitly needed.

max_summaries.description: Maximum compact summaries to return when compact mode is on.

q.description: Optional search text from the saved turn. Do not include secrets.
